messages:
laura: Heads-up — I'm about to promote chart v4.2.1 (cron timezone fix + small PVC tweak). EU canary would land at 02:30 CET which overlaps our EU maintenance window. Do we pin EU to v4.1.9 and staged-rollout US/APAC, or proceed and shift the canary time?

deploy-bot: deploybot: promotion queued -> status: BLOCKED
Reason: values drift detected for cluster eu-west: maintenanceWindow mismatch.
Action: manual review required.

sam: @laura can we just override the maintenanceWindow for the canary in eu-west to 04:00-06:00Z for this rollout? quick patch in values should work.

laura: I'd prefer not to change windows in-flight for EU critical infra. Pinning EU sounds safer.

mike: If we pin EU we'll need release notes callout and a follow-up hotpatch to v4.2.1 once window is safe. Ping ops for schedule.

olga: +1 pin EU. canary US/APAC then promote across regions after EU window. ops, can you confirm next safe window? @ops-team

deploy-bot: utils: here's the check output:
```
checks: [values-schema, maintenance-window, image-digest]
cluster eu-west: maintenanceWindow (values.yaml)=02:00-04:00Z, expected for v4.2.1=04:00-06:00Z -> DRIFT
image-digest ok
values-schema ok
```

sam: here's the quick override I tested in a sandbox (do not apply to EU prod):
```
# values override snippet
canary:
  schedule: "03:30"
clusterOverrides:
  eu-west:
    maintenanceWindow: "04:00-06:00Z"
    tzOffset: "+01:00"
```

laura: Thanks. We're going pin EU to v4.1.9 for now. Sam, can you prepare the pin command and release-note blurb? Mike, add a line to release notes about staged rollout and follow-up patch.

sam: Pin command ready:
```
helm upgrade --install myapp stable/chart --version 4.1.9 -f values-eu-pin.yaml --namespace prod-eu
```
I'll also add a short blurb: "EU pinned to 4.1.9 due to maintenance window overlap; v4.2.1 contains cron timezone fix and PVC sizing optimization, scheduled for post-window patch."

mike: I'll add release-notes section under "Deployment decisions" and mention rollback criteria: if EU canary error-rate > 1% within 30m -> rollback to 4.1.9 (automated).

olga: Ops confirmed next safe window for EU is 2024-10-02 04:00-06:00Z. Plan: pin EU now, promote US/APAC canaries tonight, schedule EU patch in that window.

laura: Great. @deploy-bot mark thread resolution: PIN_EU -> 4.1.9; schedule follow-up patch v4.2.1 for 2024-10-02 04:00Z. Add release note entries and link to this thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploybot: action taken -> label: PIN_EU, pinned_version: 4.1.9, followup_window: 2024-10-02T04:00:00Z, note: manual promotion required for EU.

sam: will open the PR with values-eu-pin.yaml and release-note draft now.

mike: thanks everyone. I'll update changelog and ship the release-notes draft to the release channel once PR merges.

laura: closing thread, moving to release checklist.
